We introduced the Pesticide Harm Accountability Act to restore your right to sue pesticide manufacturers in state court if they fail to warn you about the risks of their products. The bill would also force the EPA to identify and address federal barriers blocking these lawsuits.

If a pesticide company's product poisons you, you should be able to take them to court. Period. NO ONE
